formalAnchor.description: when this reading extends the estate's own bilattice/causal-cone/settling-closure apparatus, the specific mechanism it extends; omitted when the reading is offered in plain prose without a formal anchor, which this glossary treats as an honest choice rather than a gap to be filled by force
